notes: The source watchlist, transcribed on 6 October 2026 from the earlier NRW horizon-scanning tool (43 sources). Old lanes map to the Gwylio lanes; Audit Wales and the Future Generations Commissioner move to governance-capacity, the lane built for scrutiny bodies, and Nation.Cymru moves to independent-media. Discipline follows the old type: search_domain is osint_site, rss is osint_feed, api is osint_academic. Reliability is the Admiralty letter: A for legislation.gov.uk and official statistics publishers, B for government departments, regulators, Parliament, statutory public bodies and intergovernmental bodies, C for research bodies, established non-governmental organisations (NGOs), unions, utilities and established media, D for campaign groups and law firms, E where a source is unknown. trusted lets a hit pass the relevance gate on domain alone; site_pass lets site queries sweep the domain. The old cadence and last_ok fields are dropped: cadence was never used and last_ok is run state, not configuration. Natural Resources Wales (NRW) domains are deliberately absent: the register tracks external signals only.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.notes: PARKED 22 July 2026. Diagnosis: the APIs do loose keyword matching and effectively ignore the geographic term, so 'ecosystem resilience assessment Wales' returns global papers (1 of 15 mentioned Wales). The relevance gate then correctly drops them, giving zero promotions across every scan to date. The gate is right; the queries are wrong. To revive: use OpenAlex structured filters (institution or geography), or accept UK-wide relevance and raise the triage bar.

sources.name: UK Plant Health Information Portal
sources.notes: Statutory register of plant and tree pest and disease outbreaks across GB including Wales. Trusted so authoritative outbreak hits pass the relevance gate; site_pass off because the domain is GB-wide, so geography comes from the tight queries. Ecological shocks move SI1 and SI2 before policy names them.

sources.name: British Trust for Ornithology (BTO)
sources.notes: Wild bird and seabird monitoring; avian influenza impact on wild populations is an SI1 ecosystem-resilience signal that no policy source surfaces early. GB-wide, so geography comes from the tight queries.
